lines: You gave fear less room inside these walls.
I prayed for help and watched you answer with action.
Every neighbor still standing owes you thanks.
You reached the gate before the raiders reached our homes.
The wounded had time to shelter because you held the lane.
I heard the bell, then saw you run toward the danger.
You protected people who could not protect themselves.
The village will remember who stood outside the doors.
You brought quiet back to the square.
I treated fewer wounds because you were there.
Courage looks different up close. Today it looked like you.
You kept the fighting away from the smallest homes.
Our children slept safely after the last horn faded.
The golem did not face that attack alone.
You held your ground when everyone else needed to move.
I have thanked the stars. Now I am thanking you.
Your defense saved more than buildings.
You gave us enough time to count everyone alive.
The bell rings for danger, but tonight it can ring for gratitude.
You stood between this village and a terrible morning.
